instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: If sent to GY: add Blue-Eyes White Dragon. If this card is sent to the GY: Add 1 Blue-Eyes White Dragon from your Deck to your hand.
On Special Summon: SS any number of Hero Kid from your Deck. When this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon any number of Hero Kid(s) from your Deck.
If milled from Deck: SS this. Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by a card effect. If this card is sent from your Deck to the GY: Special Summon it.
On NS: take control of 1 face-up opp monster with 0 ATK. When this card is Normal Summoned, you can select and take control of 1 face-up monster with 0 ATK your opponent controls.
